page.notes: The top of the page is cut off, so the last letter of the title is uncertain; the running head is marked accordingly. Old-style numerals in the page references (for example 105, 310) are read as ordinary Arabic numerals. Only the visible part of the index is transcribed. The top-left "D" is cut at the edge and the running head is read as "D E X.". Entries are printed without a space between "potentiam" and "sub", and "Aristote-les" with a broken hyphen. The page numbers "2, 3" and "171 172" are read from the scan with some doubt, as is "19", which is underlined. "NArcotica" follows the rule for a joined woodcut initial and may be "Narcotica".
